current_stack_audit.old_cockpit_uses: Mixed — qsb_tower_2d.js (SVG pseudo-3D) is the dominant visible layer, qsb_scene.js (Babylon 4.x WebGL, 967 lines) is built but was hidden behind a .use-3d CSS gate until last phase.
current_stack_audit.patching_history: 5+ phases of overlay modules (qsb_3d_app, qsb_3d_workers, qsb_3d_openclaw, qsb_3d_telemetry, qsb_render_visible, qsb_3d_skyscraper_v2). All paint on top of the same 2D SVG.
current_stack_audit.why_still_weak: Operator sees the SVG cockpit as the primary visual. Babylon scene was forced on last phase, but the SVG remains at 30% opacity AND existing side panels anchor to SVG rect[data-floor] — so the SVG cannot be removed without breaking everything. The whole stack carries old visual DNA.

pros: existing qsb_scene.js proves it works on this machine
cons: 4.x is older than 6.x but still capable
requires new vendor download from CDN or local copy — adds supply-chain risk
weeks of work to match Babylon's API

decision_rationale: Already vendored — no new download, no supply-chain risk.
Proven working on this machine (existing 967-line qsb_scene.js was rendering before being hidden).
Mature scene graph + camera + material API suits a 53-floor tower without writing low-level WebGL.
Reusing the vendor means the new dashboard ships immediately without an internet fetch.

rejected_alternatives.three_js: Would require adding a new 600KB+ vendor file. No existing code in repo. Risk of supply-chain issue. Babylon already works.
rejected_alternatives.custom_webgl: Weeks of work to match Babylon's depth/lighting. Out of scope.
rejected_alternatives.react_react_three_fiber: Requires a React build pipeline. The dashboard is plain JS. Would force a build-tooling rewrite.

implementation_plan.isolation: All next3d code lives under src/dashboard/static/next3d/ — separate scene, separate CSS, separate orchestrator.
implementation_plan.engine_independence: next3d builds a FRESH Babylon engine on its own canvas. Does NOT call window.QSB_SCENE.
implementation_plan.fallback: Old cockpit at /?v=unified remains untouched and continues to work.
implementation_plan.no_svg: next3d does not use SVG for any tower element. All tower geometry is Babylon meshes.

webgl_fallback.strategy: If WebGL context creation fails, display a 'WebGL unavailable — enable hardware acceleration' message instead of falling back to a 2D placeholder. Honest failure beats fake 3D.
